children: Ellington Financial completed a private offering of $150.0 million of additional 7.375% senior unsecured notes due 2030 under its existing indenture. The notes, guaranteed by the parent, pay interest semi-annually and are callable subject to a make-whole before Sep. 30, 2027, and at declining premiums thereafter. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including repaying repurchase agreement borrowings and funding new asset purchases.

: Qualified institutional buyers and non-U.S. investors
: Refinance repos and fund asset purchases
